dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The dorsal-lateral surface features numerous 'O' shaped structures. The most prominent 3-5 structures exhibit a high-intensity white perimeter with a soft, fuzzy gradient transitioning from the dark background hide to a bright ring, and back to a dark central core. These perimeters are predominantly elliptical or sub-circular with slight irregularities in the thickness of the high-intensity bands.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Solid high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients are sparse, primarily located in the posterior region near the flipper. These manifest as small, localized white spots with high core pixel concentration, contrasting against the darker base texture.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A cluster of three macro-annuli in the upper-mid section forms an approximate scalene triangle. A second grouping of four annuli located more posteriorly forms an elongated, slightly curved chain-like spatial relationship following the longitudinal axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of long, high-intensity linear filaments, likely vibrissae, are visible in the lower foreground, overlapping the posterior-ventral section of the hide.
